title: lysionotus pterocaulis

This plant has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including hypertension, fever, and inflammation, due to its reported health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Lysionotus pterocaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
